title: Reproduce: Analysis and mining of Dupilumab adverse events based on FAERS database.
primary_question: Can an autonomous clinical-research agent reproduce the main analysis of PMID 40074775 (Analysis and mining of Dupilumab adverse events based on FAERS database.) using FAERS or its governed benchmark extract?
task: Reproduce the clinical-research workflow of PMID 40074775: Analysis and mining of Dupilumab adverse events based on FAERS database. Primary endpoint: dupilumab adverse-event reporting patterns in FAERS. Use FAERS or a locked benchmark extract derived from it. Report cohort construction, variables, statistical methods, the main reproduction result, sensitivity analyses, limitations, and one bounded new-discovery extension.
endpoint: dupilumab adverse-event reporting patterns in FAERS
rediscovery_target: Recover the reported dupilumab pharmacovigilance signal profile from FAERS.
new_discovery_target: Distinguish dermatologic drug-safety signals from causal adverse-event claims.

data.name: FAERS
data.description: FDA Adverse Event Reporting System public dashboard, quarterly files, and openFDA drug event API.
